arxiv-2011-09251.title: Toward Nonlocal Electrodynamics of Accelerated Systems
arxiv-2011-09251.creator: Bahram Mashhoon 1,2
arxiv-2011-09251.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Bahram Mashhoon 1,2. We revisit acceleration-induced nonlocal electrodynamics and the phenomenon of photon spin-rotation coupling. The kernel of the theory for the electromagnetic field tensor involves parity violation under the assumption of linearity of the field kernel in the acceleration tensor. However, we show that parity conservation can be maintained by extending the field kernel to include quadratic terms in the acceleration tensor.

arxiv-2205-14151.title: Interactive and Robust Mesh Booleans 253 Journal: TOG CCS: Computer systems organization Embedded systems CCS: Computer systems organization Redundancy CCS: Computer systems organization Robotics CCS: Networks Network reliability
arxiv-2205-14151.creator: Gianmarco Cherchi, Fabio Pellacini, Marco Attene, Marco Livesu
arxiv-2205-14151.description: Abstract . Boolean operations are among the most used paradigms to create and edit digital shapes. Despite being conceptually simple, the computation of mesh Booleans is notoriously challenging. Main issues come from numerical approximations that make the detection and processing of intersection points inconsistent and unreliable, exposing implementations based on floating point arithmetic to many kinds of degeneracy and failure.

arxiv-2206-14466.title: Integrating IoT-Sensing and Crowdsensing with Privacy: Privacy-Preserving Hybrid Sensing for Smart Cities CCS: Security and privacy Privacy-preserving protocols CCS: Computer systems organization Sensor networks CCS: Security and privacy Hardware security implementation
arxiv-2206-14466.creator: Hanwei Zhu, Sid Chi-Kin Chau, Gladhi Guarddin, Weifa Liang
arxiv-2206-14466.description: Abstract . Data sensing and gathering is an essential task for various information-driven services in smart cities. On the one hand, Internet of Things (IoT) sensors can be deployed at certain fixed locations to capture data reliably but suffer from limited sensing coverage.

arxiv-2211-00218.title: Pixel-Wise Contrastive Distillation
arxiv-2211-00218.creator: Junqiang Huang, Zichao GuoShopee jq.huang.work@gmail.com
arxiv-2211-00218.description: Abstract We present a simple but effective pixel-level self-supervised distillation framework friendly to dense prediction tasks. Our method, called Pixel-Wise Contrastive Distillation (PCD), distills knowledge by attracting the corresponding pixels from student’s and teacher’s output feature maps. PCD includes a novel design called SpatialAdaptor which “reshapes” a part of the teacher network while preserving the distribution of its output features.

arxiv-2302-01595.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Cyber System Defense under Dynamic Adversarial Uncertainties
arxiv-2302-01595.creator: Ashutosh Dutta, Samrat Chatterjee, Arnab Bhattacharya, Mahantesh Halappanavar
arxiv-2302-01595.description: Abstract Development of autonomous cyber system defense strategies and action recommendations in the real-world is challenging and includes characterizing system state uncertainties and attack-defense dynamics. We propose a data-driven deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework to learn proactive, context-aware, defense countermeasures that dynamically adapt to evolving adversarial behaviors while minimizing loss of cyber system operations.

arxiv-2311-08365.title: Local asymptotics of selection models with applications in Bayesian selective inference
arxiv-2311-08365.creator: Daniel García Rasines, G. Alastair Young
arxiv-2311-08365.description: Abstract Contemporary focus on selective inference provokes interest in the asymptotic properties of selection models, as the working inferential models in the conditional approach to inference after selection. In this paper, we derive an asymptotic expansion of the local likelihood ratios of selection models.

arxiv-2405-15011.title: Understanding the puzzle of angular momentum conservation in beta decay and related processes
arxiv-2405-15011.creator: Gordon Baym, a,b Jen-Chieh Peng a and C. J. Pethick a,b,c
arxiv-2405-15011.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Gordon Baym, a,b Jen-Chieh Peng a and C. J. Pethick a,b,c. We ask the question of how angular momentum is conserved in electroweak interaction processes. To introduce the problem with a minimum of mathematics, we first raise the same issue in elastic scattering of a circularly polarized photon by an atom, where the scattered photon has a different spin direction than the original photon, and note its presence in scattering of a fully relativistic spin-1/2 particle by a central potential.

arxiv-2406-05497.title: Holonomy of Parabolic Geometries Near Isolated Higher-Order Fixed Points
arxiv-2406-05497.creator: Jacob W. ERICKSON
arxiv-2406-05497.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jacob W. ERICKSON. For Cartan geometries admitting an automorphism with isotropy satisfying a particular, loosely dynamical property on their model geometries, we demonstrate the existence of an open subset of the geometry with trivial holonomy.

arxiv-2409-06749.title: The nature of silicon PN junction impedance at high frequency
arxiv-2409-06749.creator: David A. van Nijen, Paul Procel, René A.C.M.M. van Swaaij, Miro Zeman, Olindo Isabella, Patrizio Manganiello
arxiv-2409-06749.description: Abstract A thorough understanding of the small-signal response of solar cells can reveal intrinsic device characteristics and pave the way for innovations. This study investigates the impedance of crystalline silicon PN junction devices using TCAD simulations, focusing on the impact of frequency, bias voltage, and the presence of a low-high (LH) junction.

arxiv-2502-12690.title: Fast Data Aware Neural Architecture Search via Supernet Accelerated Evaluation
arxiv-2502-12690.creator: Emil Njor, Colby Banbury, Xenofon Fafoutis
arxiv-2502-12690.description: Abstract Tiny machine learning (TinyML) promises to revolutionize fields such as healthcare, environmental monitoring, and industrial maintenance by running machine learning models on low-power embedded systems. However, the complex optimizations required for successful TinyML deployment continue to impede its widespread adoption.

arxiv-2503-01930.title: Road Boundary Detection Using 4D mmWave Radar for Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2503-01930.creator: Yuyan Wu, Hae Young Noh
arxiv-2503-01930.description: Abstract Detecting road boundaries, the static physical edges of the available driving area, is important for safe navigation and effective path planning in autonomous driving and advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS). Traditionally, road boundary detection in autonomous driving relies on cameras and LiDAR.

arxiv-2507-17379.title: Language-Conditioned Open-Vocabulary Mobile Manipulation with Pretrained Models
arxiv-2507-17379.creator: Shen Tan, Dong ZhouXiangyu ShaoJunqiao WangGuanghui Sun
arxiv-2507-17379.description: Abstract Open-vocabulary mobile manipulation (OVMM) that involves the handling of novel and unseen objects across different workspaces remains a significant challenge for real-world robotic applications. In this paper, we propose a novel Language-conditioned Open-Vocabulary Mobile Manipulation framework, named LOVMM, incorporating the large language model (LLM) and vision-language model (VLM) to tackle various mobile manipulation tasks in household environments.

arxiv-2510-17704.title: Einstein gravity extended by a scale covariant scalar field with Bekenstein term and dynamical mass generation
arxiv-2510-17704.creator: Erhard Scholz
arxiv-2510-17704.description: Abstract Under carefully chosen assumptions a single general relativistic scalar field is able to induce MOND-like dynamics in the weak field approximation of the Einstein frame (gauge) and to modify the light cone structure accordingly. This is shown by a Lagrangian model formulated in the framework of integrable Weyl geometry.

pmc-11336084.title: Targeting of mutant-p53 and MYC as a novel strategy to inhibit oncogenic SPAG5 activity in triple negative breast cancer
pmc-11336084.creator: Valeria Canu, Sebastiano Vaccarella, Andrea Sacconi, Claudio Pulito, Frauke Goeman, Matteo Pallocca, Daniela Rutigliano, Sima Lev, Sabrina Strano, Giovanni Blandino
pmc-11336084.description: Triple negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an aggressive disease which currently has no effective therapeutic targets and prominent biomarkers. The Sperm Associated antigen 5 (SPAG5) is a mitotic spindle associated protein with oncogenic function in several human cancers. In TNBC, increased SPAG5 expression has been associated with tumor progression, chemoresistance, relapse, and poor clinical outcome.

pmc-11363806.title: A Participatory Model for Cocreating Accessible Rehabilitation Technology for Stroke Survivors: User-Centered Design Approach
pmc-11363806.creator: Andrew Kerr, Madeleine Grealy, Milena Slachetka, Chioma Obinuchi Wodu, Gillian Sweeney, Fiona Boyd, David Colville, Philip Rowe
pmc-11363806.description: BackgroundGlobally, 1 in 3 people live with health conditions that could be improved with rehabilitation. Ideally, this is provided by trained professionals delivering evidence-based dose, intensity, and content of rehabilitation for optimal recovery. The widely acknowledged inability of global health care providers to deliver recommended levels of rehabilitation creates an opportunity for technological innovation.

pmc-11584366.title: Single‐cell RNA‐seq in diabetic foot ulcer wound healing
pmc-11584366.creator: Yan Dong, Mengting Wang, Qianqian Wang, Xiaoliang Cao, Peng Chen, Zhenhua Gong
pmc-11584366.description: Diabetic foot ulcer (DFU) is a chronic and serious complication of diabetes mellitus. It is mainly caused by hyperglycaemia, diabetic peripheral vasculopathy and diabetic peripheral neuropathy. These conditions result in ulceration of foot tissues and chronic wounds. If left untreated, DFU can lead to amputation or even endanger the patient's life.

pmc-12812981.title: Maternal influenza vaccination during pregnancy and the risk of adverse pregnancy and birth outcomes
pmc-12812981.creator: Vanina Tchuente, Odile Sheehy, Gina Muckle, Mark Walker, William D. Fraser, Anick Bérard
pmc-12812981.description: BackgroundInfluenza vaccination is recommended during pregnancy. We aimed to assess pregnancy and newborns’ outcomes.MethodsParticipants were recruited in their first trimester of gestation, from 05/25/2010 to 08/30/2012. Data were collected, each trimester through telephone-administered interviews. Influenza vaccine exposure was defined as a report of AH1N1 or seasonal influenza vaccine, within 6 months before the last menstrual period or during pregnancy.

pmc-13420707.title: The Metabolic-Inflammatory Axis in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
pmc-13420707.creator: Katharina J Ermer, Vasco Sequeira
pmc-13420707.description: Corresponding AuthorKey words: fibrosis, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, hypertrophy, inflammation, macrophages, metabolism, pioglitazone Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is the prototypical sarcomere disease. It affects 0.2% to 0.5% of adults,1 with ∼35% carrying a pathogenic sarcomere-gene variant, most often MYBPC3 or MYH7.2 These variants destabilize myosin's resting (energy-conserving) state, releasing more heads to form force-producing cross-bridges.
